practiceReport.name: Hjalte Froholdt
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (8th NFL season, 100% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.

practiceReport.beatComment: Froholdt was a full practice participant both Thursday and Friday, and he's progressed enough in his recovery to clear the league's concussion protocol. With Jon Gaines (ankle) ruled out, Froholdt should reclaim his starting job at center for Sunday's road tilt.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jeremiyah Love
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: "I'll know a little bit more as this week goes," LaFleur noted of Love, who will miss at least one more game before potentially being activated ahead of, and available for, Week 13 action. Love sustained a right high-ankle sprain Nov. 1, and at the time he was thought to be facing a projected recovery timeline of 4-to-5 weeks. However, for this coming weekend's game against the Commanders at least, Tyler Allgeier and Bam Knight will continue to handle Arizona's backfield duties.
